sentences.text: The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.24615/2022, pending on the file of the XLI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 504 and 506 r/w. 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: XLI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the parties in unison submit that during the pendency of this petition, the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement before the concerned Court.
A copy of the memorandum of settlement and a joint affidavit is filed to that effect before this Court, which also recognizes the closure of the impugned proceedings.
It is also submitted that the terms and conditions of the settlement are fulfilled.

3. The memorandum of settlement insofar as it concerns the subject lis, reads as follows:
"4. The respondent is herewith paying a sum of Rs.8,00,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs only) towards all the claims of permanent alimony/ maintenance to the petitioner by way of Demand Draft bearing No.003829, dated 12.04.2023 drawn on Axis Bank, Kodichikkanahalli Branch, Bengaluru as full and final settlement.
The said Demand draft shall be handed over to the petitioner at the time of reporting settlement before this Hon'ble Court.

5. The respondent herein has filed a Criminal Revision Petition under section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code bearing Crl.P.12061/2022, pending before the High Court of Karnataka challenging the proceedings initiated against him in C.C.No.24615/2022 pending before the 41st Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bengaluru, filed under sections 498A, 506, 504, 323 and 3 & 4 of D.P. Act bearing.

entities.text: 41st Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner undertakes/ agrees to co-operate to get the proceeding in C.C.24615/2022 quashed."

In terms of the afore-extracted memorandum of settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to terminate the proceedings initiated against the petitioners for the afore-quoted offences, which are the ones punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 504 and 506 r/w. 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, and the same are not against the State.
4.
For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.24615/2022, pending on the file of the XLI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, stand quashed, qua the petitioners.
I.A.No.1/2022 is disposed, as a consequence.
